# VelNexis

> The nexus of tech truth, tips and trends. Rumors challenged, fixes that work, zero fluff — built for readers first.

VelNexis publishes step by step tech guides and honest rumor checks: Windows, Android, iPhone, apps, WiFi, printers, cameras, payments, AI and more. 330 articles across 20 categories, written by Abdul Rafay.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://velnexis.netlify.app/): latest articles and all categories
- [All Categories](https://velnexis.netlify.app/categories.html): every section in one place
- [Search](https://velnexis.netlify.app/search.html): search all 330 guides by keyword
- [About](https://velnexis.netlify.app/about.html): how the site works and its editorial standards
- [Author](https://velnexis.netlify.app/author.html): Abdul Rafay, founder and author
- [Contact](https://velnexis.netlify.app/contact.html): questions, corrections and rumor reports
- [Privacy Policy](https://velnexis.netlify.app/privacy.html): data and cookie policy
- [Sitemap](https://velnexis.netlify.app/sitemap.xml): full URL list
